description: Compose, edit, orchestrate, visualize, and render MIDI music with a deterministic SoundFont synthesizer. Generate structured arrangements, modify individual passages, control expression, and export WAV and MIDI.

defaultPrompt: Compose a 32-bar four-voice Baroque fugue in D minor at 108 BPM with organ instrumentation and expressive CC11 dynamics. Render WAV and MIDI.
Make measures 17–24 more dramatic. Add an octave doubling to the bass, increase the dynamics using CC11, preserve the earlier sections, and render the revised piece.
Show me the piano roll and let me download both files.
interface.longDescription: GBK Composer lets you compose, edit, orchestrate, visualize, and render MIDI music with a deterministic SoundFont synthesizer, directly from ChatGPT or Codex. Create durable compositions with structured arrangements — including Baroque fugues, counterpoint, and multi-voice writing — modify individual passages without disturbing the rest, control expression with MIDI CC automation, and export validated stereo WAV and Standard MIDI files. Every composition is saved server-side under your GBK account, can be revised by follow-up prompts, played and inspected in an interactive player with a piano-roll view, and opened in GBK Studio for full editing.
interface.shortDescription: Compose, edit, and render structured MIDI music to WAV and MIDI.

name: gbk-composer
